findings.title: The meta description is 184 characters long
findings.detail: Descriptions under 70 characters waste the space. Over 160 they are cut off.
findings.fix: Rewrite the meta description to between 70 and 160 characters.

evidence.note: meta description
evidence.quote: George is an AI engineer in Melbourne who designs, builds and deploys AI applications end to end: agent pipelines, retrieval, evaluation and the infrastructure…

findings.title: The homepage has no canonical link
findings.detail: A canonical link tells search engines which URL is the main one when the same page is reachable at several.
findings.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.georgemridun.dev/"> to the page head.

evidence.note: no <link rel="canonical">

findings.title: The site has no robots.txt file
findings.detail: robots.txt tells crawlers what they may visit and where the sitemap is.
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt at the site root that allows crawling and lists the sitemap URL.

evidence.note: not found, or not a text file

findings.title: No XML sitemap was found
findings.detail: A sitemap helps search engines find every page, including ones that are not well linked.
findings.fix: Generate an XML sitemap, serve it at /sitemap.xml, and reference it from robots.txt.

evidence.note: not found, or not a sitemap

findings.title: The site is missing 3 standard security headers
findings.detail: These headers stop other sites framing the page, sniffing its files as another type, and leaking full URLs to third parties. Missing: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options or a CSP frame-ancestors rule, Referrer-Policy.
findings.fix: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (or a CSP frame-ancestors rule) and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin from the web server or CDN.

evidence.note: missing: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options or a CSP frame-ancestors rule, Referrer-Policy

findings.title: 2 of 2 images have no width and height
findings.detail: Without width and height attributes the browser cannot reserve space for an image, so the text moves when it loads. That is the main cause of a poor layout-shift (CLS) score.
findings.fix: Add width and height attributes matching each image's real size, and keep max-width: 100% in the CSS so it still scales.

evidence.note: first image without width and height

findings.title: The homepage does not link to any other page
findings.detail: Internal links are how search engines discover pages and how authority flows from the homepage to the rest of the site. A homepage with almost none leaves the other pages hard to find.
findings.fix: Link from the homepage to the main service, product and contact pages with descriptive anchor text, not just "click here".

evidence.note: 0 distinct internal pages linked

findings.title: No organisation schema tells AI systems who runs this site
findings.detail: Organization or LocalBusiness markup gives AI systems a reliable source for the brand name, logo, location and profiles.
findings.fix: Add Organization (or LocalBusiness) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, sameAs links and contact details.

evidence.note: schema types found: Person, PostalAddress

findings.title: The page does not answer questions in a form AI systems can lift
findings.detail: AI answers are built from passages that directly answer a question. Question headings with a short answer underneath are the easiest to cite.
findings.fix: Add an FAQ or question-style H2 and H3 headings, each followed by a direct two-to-three sentence answer.

evidence.note: no question headings and no FAQPage schema

findings.title: The site has no llms.txt file
findings.detail: llms.txt is an emerging convention that gives AI agents a short guide to the site. Google Search ignores it, so this is a small bonus, not a requirement.
findings.fix: Add a /llms.txt with a one-paragraph summary of the business and links to its most important pages.

evidence.note: not found

findings.title: Nothing on the page says when it was written or last updated
findings.detail: AI answer engines and Google favour content that shows it is current. A machine-readable date (a Last-Modified header, a <time datetime> element, or datePublished/dateModified in the schema) is how they tell.
findings.fix: Add dateModified (and datePublished) to the page's JSON-LD, or wrap the "last updated" date in <time datetime="2026-01-31">.

evidence.note: no Last-Modified header, <time datetime>, article date meta tag or schema date found

findings.title: The next step is not clear
findings.detail: Pages convert better with one obvious next step worded as a specific action. The review found the next step unclear.
findings.fix: Use one primary button with a specific action label such as Get a free quote, and repeat it down the page.

evidence.quote: Scan your own repo, right here.
evidence.note: passage the AI review pointed to

findings.title: The mobile performance score is 85 out of 100
findings.detail: Slow pages lose visitors and rank lower, especially on mobile. 90 and above is considered good.
findings.fix: Work through the PageSpeed Insights opportunities: compress images, remove unused JavaScript and defer non-critical scripts.

evidence.note: Performance score 85/100. Measured by Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile lab data.

findings.title: The main content takes 3.6 s to appear
findings.detail: Largest Contentful Paint measures when the main content is visible. Under 2.5 s is good.
findings.fix: Optimise the hero image or heading: compress and size the image, preload it, and cut render-blocking CSS and JavaScript.

evidence.note: LCP 3.6 s (good is under 2.5 s). Measured by Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile lab data.

findings.title: Nothing appears on screen for 2.0 s
findings.detail: First Contentful Paint measures when the first content shows. Under 1.8 s is good.
findings.fix: Reduce server response time, inline critical CSS and remove render-blocking resources.

evidence.note: FCP 2.0 s (good is under 1.8 s). Measured by Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile lab data.

fixKit.title: Canonical tag
fixKit.note: Tells search engines this address is the main version of the page. Use the page's own address on every page.

fixKit.title: robots.txt
fixKit.content:
User-agent: *
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://www.georgemridun.dev/sitemap.xml
fixKit.note: Merge this with any rules you already need (such as blocking admin pages). The AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot) are not listed: blocking them is your choice and does not remove the site from AI search.

fixKit.title: sitemap.xml
fixKit.note: Lists the 1 page SiteRecon found. Add the rest of your pages, or generate the file from your site, and add a lastmod date only if it is the real date the page last changed.
